row: Subjects in Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation

This channel serves to provide education material for patients, their families and friends and non-medical laypeople on Spinal cord injuries (SCI), how they can affect functioning in everyday lives and how the use of therapy techniques with your therapist or at home can be implemented to improve participation in everyday activities.  Subjects will range from ADLs (activities such as activities as feeding, grooming and dressing) transfers from different surfaces and upper extremity management after a SCI; which all can become more difficult after a SCI.
These videos are for educational purposes only, and one should consult their medical doctor and/or rehabilitation specialist (physical or occupational therapist prior to implementing anything seen in theses videos.
